question: What ordered ritual actions must precede the performance of the pedestal placement?
premises: Placements are to be done for each of the six limbs.
These placements are completed before the next step.
The pedestal placement is then to be performed.
inference: After performing the placement for each of the six limbs, one should perform the pedestal placement.
plain_english: Having performed the placement for each of the six limbs, one should then perform the pedestal placement.
